description: Armoires de distribution électrique dédiées à l'éclairage public is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIGERLy (Syndicat de Gestion des Energies de la Région Lyonnaise). Geographical data relating to electrical distribution cabinets dedicated to street lighting managed by SIGERLy. Coverage: SIGERLy (Syndicat de Gestion des Energies de la Région Lyonnaise). The portal shows the English title as "Electrical distribution cabinets for public lighting" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SIGERLy (Syndicat de Gestion des Energies de la Région Lyonnaise). Its keywords include outdoor-lighting. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
